main_text.p: illæ habent: vel αἰτιολογικὰςSententiae in mittendis scriptis personis & operibus à Cic., quibus fufce-pti laboris causæ indicantur: & aut ab a-micorum voluntate & petitionibus cre-bris: aut ocio concesso: aut temporum conditione Reipublicæ statu: aut mate-riæ vtilitate petuntur: vel παραιτητικὰςVsurpata., ad le-ctionem hortantes afsiduam: vel ἀπολογη-τικὰς ἢ παραιτητικὰς, excusationes continen-tes difficultatis, obscuritatis, tarditatis, li-bertatis aut acerbitatis in scribendo, sum-ptas à rei indignitate: aut personæ impro-bitate: aut aliorum exemplis: vel deniq; διατυπωτικὰς, quibus ordo atq; methodus significatur. Ad tractationem vero atqueTractatio & collocatio sententiarum. collocationem quod attinet, etsi eius in-dicari certa via atq; ratio commodè ne-queat, propterea quod non folitarie eius-cemodi mifsiones, sed cum aliis plerunq; materiis coniunctæ in epistolis reperian-tur: tamen ita fere institui ea solet: vt pri-mum teneat locum, ἐκθέσεως αἰτίων caufarum expofitio, mifsi ad amicum operis. lib.7. Epist. 19. lib. 9. Epist. 8. 12. lib.12.Epist.19. lib.15.Epist.20. Sequatur deinde: vel ἐνδείξεως[?] significatio methodi. lib.7.Epist.19.lib. 9.Epist.8.vel occupatio,quæ excusatione habeat aut difficultatis & obscuritatis li-bro 7.Epist.19.lib.9. Epist.8.aut παρα[?]ις li

page.notes: Marginal notes are in the right margin, beside the text. The word "Vsurpata." is a single marginal word; it is printed beside the line "vel παραιτητικὰς" and is read as "Usurpata." The Greek words are copied as best as the scan allows. Words marked [?] are uncertain: the Greek accents, the superscript letters after "vel", and the last Greek word "παρα[?]ις" are not fully legible. The line ending "li" is a fragment that continues on the next page. Where the printed hyphen was part of a line-break, it is kept.
